The structure of Hf₂Pd₂ (HfPd) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing four atoms across two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Hf and Pd centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each (6 Hf and 6 Pd), at distances of 2.876–3.016 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Hf–Pd 12-vertex coordination polyhedra connected by corner, edge, and face contacts, while Hf–Hf and Pd–Pd pairs share corners and edges.
